accountingOwnership.rule: Quotation/invoice billing records retain payable and shared tax breakdown. Billing memorandum does not itself create insurer IFRS 17 insurance service revenue. Cash executions, fees and taxes use their own approved events and single ownership.

Dedicated measurement records, assumptions, reproducible runs and approved result versions; Finance posts the approved movement exactly once. Reconcile provisional claims, insurance balances and held reinsurance component by component; never layer a full measured liability on an unreversed duplicate operational liability.

Only separately scoped financial assets/exposures outside the relevant IFRS 17 ownership; evidence for rights/discharge and impairment scope. No second premium receivable/ECL effect over the same IFRS 17 cash flows.

Tag transaction/functional/presentation currency and rate evidence; assign FX ownership per exposure and measured component. Revaluation/translation and IFRS 17 finance movements must reconcile, not produce duplicate FX.
